UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores information about users (students and teachers) within the ScholarMate AI application. Assumes external authentication for credentials.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

externalAuthId.description: Reference to the unique identifier from an external authentication system.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user, used for communication.

role.description: The role of the user within the application.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: Represents an uploaded study material (PDF, PPTX, DOCX) by a student or syllabus/topic definitions by a teacher, serving as source content for AI generation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Document entity.

uploaderId.description: Reference to the UserProfile of the user who uploaded or provided this document content. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Document)

title.description: User-provided or AI-extracted title for the document.

fileName.description: The original file name of the uploaded document (if applicable).

fileUrl.description: The URL where the document content is stored (e.g., cloud storage).

fileType.description: The MIME type or file extension of the uploaded document (e.g., 'application/pdf').

uploadDate.description: Timestamp when the document was uploaded.

processedStatus.description: Current processing status of the document by AI (e.g., 'pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed').

extractedConcepts.description: An array of key concepts or keywords extracted from the document by AI.

processingDetails.description: Optional details or error messages related to the AI processing of the document (can be a JSON string).

Quiz.title: Quiz
Quiz.description: Represents a quiz generated by the AI, based on user input or uploaded documents, containing multiple questions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Quiz entity.

creatorId.description: Reference to the UserProfile (teacher or student) who generated or initiated this quiz. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Quiz)

documentIds.description: References to Document entities that were used as source material for generating this quiz. (Relationship: Document N:N Quiz)

title.description: The title or name of the quiz.

description.description: An optional descriptive text about the quiz.

difficulty.description: The overall difficulty level of the quiz.

questionCount.description: The total number of questions included in the quiz.

quizType.description: The primary type of questions in the quiz (e.g., 'MCQ', 'Mixed', 'Conceptual').

generationDate.description: Timestamp when the quiz was generated.

syllabusKeywords.description: Keywords or specific topics used by the teacher for quiz generation.

isTimerBased.description: Indicates if the quiz is designed to be completed within a specific time limit.

timerDurationMinutes.description: The duration of the timer for the quiz, in minutes, if it is timer-based.

Question.title: Question
Question.description: Represents a single question within a quiz, including its text, type, and answers.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Question entity.

quizId.description: Reference to the Quiz entity this question belongs to. (Relationship: Quiz 1:N Question)

questionText.description: The full text of the question.

options.description: An array of possible answer options for multiple-choice questions. Empty for other types.

correctAnswer.description: The correct answer to the question. For MCQ, this might be the text of the correct option or an index indicator.

explanation.description: An optional explanation or rationale for the correct answer.

difficultyRating.description: AI-assigned difficulty rating for this specific question.

QuizAttempt.title: QuizAttempt
QuizAttempt.description: Records a student's attempt at a specific quiz, including their score, submission details, and time taken.

id.description: Unique identifier for the QuizAttempt entity.

studentId.description: Reference to the UserProfile of the student who made this attempt. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N QuizAttempt)

quizId.description: Reference to the Quiz entity that was attempted. (Relationship: Quiz 1:N QuizAttempt)

attemptDate.description: Timestamp when the quiz attempt was submitted.

score.description: The student's score achieved in this quiz attempt.

totalQuestions.description: The total number of questions in the quiz at the time of this attempt.

timeTakenSeconds.description: The duration, in seconds, the student took to complete the quiz.

submissionDetails.description: A structured representation (e.g., JSON string) of the student's responses to each question and their correctness.

isCompleted.description: Indicates whether the quiz attempt was fully completed and submitted.

Note.title: Note
Note.description: Stores structured notes generated by the AI for students, based on their uploaded documents or prompts.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Note entity.

studentId.description: Reference to the UserProfile of the student who owns these notes. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Note)

documentId.description: Reference to the Document entity from which these notes were generated. (Relationship: Document 1:N Note)

title.description: A descriptive title for the generated notes.

generatedContent.description: The AI-generated structured notes content (e.g., Markdown, HTML, or a structured JSON string).

generationDate.description: Timestamp when the notes were generated.

summary.description: A concise summary of the notes.

detailedContentToggle.description: Indicates if the notes have a toggleable detailed view, implying the 'generatedContent' contains both summarized and detailed versions.

keyConcepts.description: An array of key concepts or highlights extracted and present within these notes.

StudySchedule.title: StudySchedule
StudySchedule.description: Stores personalized study schedules, timetables, and daily challenges generated by the AI for students.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudySchedule entity.

studentId.description: Reference to the UserProfile of the student for whom this schedule was generated. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N StudySchedule)

title.description: A descriptive title for the study schedule (e.g., 'Weekly Study Plan', 'Exam Prep').

startDate.description: The calendar start date of the study schedule.

endDate.description: The calendar end date of the study schedule.

scheduleContent.description: The structured content of the schedule, detailing tasks, timings, and topics (e.g., a JSON string).

generationDate.description: Timestamp when the study schedule was generated.

isActive.description: Indicates if this is the student's currently active study schedule.

dailyChallenges.description: An array of strings describing daily challenges included in this schedule.

Reminder.title: Reminder
Reminder.description: Stores reminders for students, linked to study schedules or specific tasks.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Reminder entity.

studentId.description: Reference to the UserProfile of the student to whom this reminder is addressed. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Reminder)

studyScheduleId.description: Optional reference to the StudySchedule this reminder is associated with. (Relationship: StudySchedule 1:N Reminder)

reminderText.description: The text content of the reminder notification.

scheduledTime.description: The specific date and time when the reminder is scheduled to be triggered.

isDismissed.description: Indicates whether the reminder has been acknowledged or dismissed by the user.

type.description: The category or type of reminder (e.g., 'schedule', 'quiz_deadline', 'custom').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the reminder was created.

definition.description: Stores user profiles for both students and teachers. Access is restricted to the owner (`userId` matches `request.auth.uid`) and potentially administrative roles.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user, corresponding to `request.auth.uid`.

definition.description: Documents uploaded by a user (students for study materials, teachers for syllabus/topics). Ownership is established by the `userId` in the path.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who uploaded the document.

params.name: documentId
params.description: The unique identifier of the document.

definition.description: AI-generated notes for a student, typically based on their uploaded documents. Ownership is established by the `userId` in the path.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the student who owns these notes.

params.name: noteId
params.description: The unique identifier of the generated note.

definition.description: AI-generated personalized study schedules for a student. Ownership is established by the `userId` in the path.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the student for whom this schedule was generated.

params.name: scheduleId
params.description: The unique identifier of the study schedule.

definition.description: Reminders for a student, potentially linked to their study schedules. Ownership is established by the `userId` in the path.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the student to whom this reminder is addressed.

params.name: reminderId
params.description: The unique identifier of the reminder.

definition.description: Quizzes generated by a user (student or teacher) for their private use or self-practice. Ownership is established by the `userId` in the path.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who created this personal quiz.

params.name: quizId
params.description: The unique identifier of the personal quiz.

definition.description: Questions belonging to a user's personal quiz. Access is inherited from the parent `personalQuiz`.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns the parent quiz.

params.name: quizId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent personal quiz.

params.name: questionId
params.description: The unique identifier of the question.

definition.description: Quizzes generated by teachers and published for students. This document includes denormalized `creatorId` (teacher's UID), `isPublic` (boolean), and `sharedWithStudents` (map of student UIDs to boolean) for authorization independence and QAP capabilities.

params.name: quizId
params.description: The unique identifier of the published quiz.

definition.description: Questions belonging to a published quiz. Access is inherited from the parent `publishedQuiz` document, which holds the authorization context.

params.name: quizId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent published quiz.

params.name: questionId
params.description: The unique identifier of the question.

definition.description: Records a student's attempt at any quiz (personal or published). Ownership is established by the `userId` in the path, ensuring privacy of attempts.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the student who made this quiz attempt.

params.name: quizAttemptId
params.description: The unique identifier of the quiz attempt.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure for ScholarMate AI is designed following core principles of authorization independence, structural segregation, and predictable access modeling to ensure security, scalability, and debuggability. All user-specific data, such as `documents`, `notes`, `studySchedules`, `reminders`, and `personalQuizzes`, are organized under a path-based ownership model: `/userProfiles/{userId}/<collection>/{documentId}`. This structure inherently makes `request.auth.uid` the owner and simplifies security rules, as access is granted if `request.auth.uid == userId` in the path. This directly supports **Authorization Independence** as the user's identity is part of the document's location, eliminating the need for `get()` calls to verify ownership for these personal resources. It also ensures **Query Against Permissions (QAPs)** as a user can only list documents within their own `/userProfiles/{userId}` subtree.

For quizzes, **Structural Segregation** is applied by differentiating between `personalQuizzes` (private to the creator, residing under their user profile) and `publishedQuizzes` (teacher-generated quizzes intended for wider student access). The `publishedQuizzes` collection is a top-level collection (`/publishedQuizzes/{quizId}`) to enable easy discovery by students and teachers without needing to know a specific teacher's UID. For **Authorization Independence** and **QAPs** in `publishedQuizzes`, each quiz document will include denormalized authorization fields: `creatorId` (the teacher's UID) and a `sharedWithStudents` map (e.g., `{ 'studentUid1': true, 'studentUid2': true }`) or an `isPublic` boolean. This allows security rules to evaluate access directly from the `publishedQuiz` document and enables efficient queries like `db.collection('publishedQuizzes').where('isPublic', '==', true)` or `db.collection('publishedQuizzes').where('sharedWithStudents.<current_user_uid>', '==', true)`. This eliminates `get()` calls to other user profiles for authorization validation for `publishedQuizzes` itself.

Questions are structured as subcollections of their respective quizzes (e.g., `/userProfiles/{userId}/personalQuizzes/{quizId}/questions/{questionId}` and `/publishedQuizzes/{quizId}/questions/{questionId}`). For these nested resources, authorization rules may perform a `get()` call on the *immediate parent* document (the `Quiz` document). This is an accepted pattern as the parent document itself contains the necessary access control data, and it maintains clarity of intent, ensuring that access to a question is intrinsically linked to access to its parent quiz. This does not violate the spirit of Authorization Independence as it's validating access within a single logical resource hierarchy rather than traversing unrelated data.

`QuizAttempts` are also user-owned, stored under `/userProfiles/{userId}/quizAttempts/{quizAttemptId}`, ensuring that each student's attempts are private and directly accessible by them. The `studentId` in the path directly fulfills the ownership invariant.

Overall, the design prioritizes simple and robust security rules by making authorization explicit either through path-based ownership or denormalized access control fields, supporting efficient queries, and clearly segregating data with different security postures.
